caption:
बॉम्ब थ्रेट मिलने के कुछ ही दिनों बाद बिग बी ने दिखाया अपना वही पुराना अंदाज़! 🚨

मुंबई में अमिताभ बच्चन के घर जलसा के बाहर भारी सुरक्षा के बीच इस रविवार भी फैंस का तांता लगा रहा। 🌟
शुक्रवार को बीएमसी मेयर रितु तावड़े के ऑफिस और बांद्रा-कुर्ला कॉम्प्लेक्स के एक स्कूल को ईमेल के जरिए बॉम्ब थ्रेट मिला था। 📧
इस धमकी भरे ईमेल में अमिताभ बच्चन, सिंगर-एक्टर दिलजीत दोसांझ और कई स्कूलों को निशाना बनाने की बात सामने आई थी। ⚠️
मुंबई पुलिस इस पूरे मामले की गंभीरता से जांच कर रही है और घर के बाहर कड़ा पहरा है। 👮‍♂️
इस दौरान अमिताभ ने अपने सिग्नेचर स्टाइल में हाथ जोड़कर फैंस का शुक्रिया अदा किया और उनके साथ बेटे अभिषेक बच्चन भी नजर आए। 🤝
सेहत को लेकर बुधवार और शुक्रवार को ब्लॉग और Tumblr पर उन्होंने आराम करने की बात कही थी, और डॉक्टरों की सख्त सलाह के बाद वह इन दिनों KBC होस्ट कर रहे हैं। 📺

क्या आपको लगता है कि सेलेब्स को मिलने वाली ऐसी धमकियों पर प्रशासन को और सख्त होना चाहिए? 💭

ctx.title: Amitabh Bachchan greets fans outside Jalsa amid heavy security for bomb threat probe, days after sparking concern about his health
ctx.summary: There was also a bomb threat email allegedly targeting actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow in Mumbai, that was reported to Mumbai Police on Friday.
ctx.text:
Veteran star Amitabh Bachchan has been interacting with fans outside his residence in Mumbai, Jalsa, every Sunday. This is a tradition he has been continuing for years. This Sunday too, Amitabh made it a point to briefly come out of his house and greet hundreds of fans. The interaction comes after the actor allegedly recieved bomb threat email recently.
The office of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) Mayor Ritu Tawde on Friday received a bomb threat email, with the message also threatening Bollywood actor Amitabh Bachchan, singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh and several city-based schools.
Amitabh waved to the crowd in his signature style and expressed gratitude for their love and affection. He was joined by his son and actor Abhishek Bachchan. The fans were stationed outside the residence, while Mumbai Police personnel stood near Amitabh Bachchan to ensure his security. Abhishek Bachchan also stood behind the veteran actor, keeping a watchful eye on the crowd.
A bomb threat email allegedly targeting veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow in Mumbai was reported to Mumbai Police on Friday. The threatening email was received by a school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area. Mumbai Police have launched an investigation into the matter.
Meanwhile, Amitabh Bachchan raised quite a few eyebrows on Wednesday as he shared a post on his blog about his health condition. He shared that he will take a break from his usual social media updates after being advised to rest and recover. On Friday, Amitabh shared another health update on his Tumblr account. He said, “Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering ..the human body and its uniqueness.”
Earlier, he made a post on X in which he revealed the doctor's advice and wrote in Hindi, "Apologies. I seek forgiveness. I have been advised to take a few days off to rest and recover, so I am unable to write anything at the moment." While extending his Dussehra wishes, the actor said he had been given strict instructions to focus on his recovery and avoid communication for the time being.
"First Dussehra greetings to all .. love happiness, fulfilment, prayers. Under very strict rest and recuperation .. so am not allowed to communicate .. do excuse .. my apologies," he wrote. He also added, “But do take this as my respected response .. more hopefully later.”
Amitabh Bachchan is currently hosting the quiz reality show Kaun Banega Crorepati. On the cinema front, the actor was last seen in the Tamil film Vettaiyan, which starred Rajinikanth in the lead role.
